title: •Defensive Fire
caption: •Defensive Fire (V)
game_text: If opponent just initiated battle, immediately fire a non-lightsaber, non-{lightsaber} weapon present (for free and each weapon destiny is +2). That weapon may fire again this battle.
lore: 275 gunners manning 60 turbolaser batteries provide a wide firing arc. Even so, asteroids are a challenge due to the sluggish recharge rates of the high-powered blasters.
